[h1]【Animal】-【SydailyFox】[/h1]
A cute furry fox ! Cute, docile, playful and capable Little Fox ! You can find them in polar ecosystems (0.0142~0.024, other:0.0042~0.0102) . One thing to note is that SydailyFox has a very specific attack style, so be very careful when you call they a fight !
！！！Use Animal Range Attack from-【https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1263611490 [BrokenValkyrie]】- With some special work --------Don't need to install this mod.(It is self-contained.)
